title: Ind-smoothness lifts along nilpotent thickenings of the base
statement: Let $R\to\Lambda$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $I\subset R$ an ideal. Assume (1) $I$ is nilpotent ($I^n=0$ for some $n\ge1$), (2) $\Lambda/I\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R/I$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras], and (3) $R\to\Lambda$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then $\Lambda$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R$-algebras.
